PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
No. 1927/17 – MONDAY, AUGUST 10, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (Chapter 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.:MADU/L/05/349. Land Ministry No. 4/3/9/2012/IR/169.
I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a Rambakenoya Project.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Allotments of Land in P. P. MO255 prepared by the Superintend surveyor in Moneragla, situated in Damanegama village in the Madulla Divisional Secretary’s Division of the District of Moneragala in Uva Province described as follows:
